payload.title: Never replace a live page before checking what it captures
payload.question: redesigned landing page and lost signups
payload.symptom: A better looking page ships and enquiries quietly stop.
payload.cause: The old page was doing something invisible in the markup — a form wired to a vendor inbox, a chat widget, a tracking hook — and the replacement did not carry it.
payload.measured: A form endpoint present on the old builder page was absent from the replacement. Every visitor in that window hit a dead form and left no trace.
payload.fix: Before migrating any customer-facing surface, enumerate what it captures, sends and receives, and prove the replacement does the same BEFORE cutover.
payload.why_it_matters: A prettier page that captures nothing is strictly worse than an ugly one that captures, and the loss is invisible because non-events are not logged.
